For B(s)=[[1,s],[1,1+s]], det(I−B(s)^3)=−s(s+3)^2 and det(I−B(s)^2B(t))=−(s+3)(2s+(1+s)t). Substitution of the slopes gives the four stated factors and finiteness off η=1/3. A separately written and executed exact-rational replay, /workspace/branches/214277fe-0dd4-44e7-9abc-8cb7c20996b3/independent_replay.py, checked all 512 resonant cells. Exactly four rank-zero cells have compatible translations, each reducing to a singleton by the rotation-center argument; twelve positive-length rank-one pieces survive. Their pairwise intersections modulo the lattice and their endpoint incidence give six disjoint maximal segments, with two each of squared lengths 4/81, 8/81 and 20/81. The only H-fixed torus points are (0,0) and (0,2/3), neither on those segments. H must permute the components in cycles of length dividing three, and an invariant interval would be pointwise fixed since an interval homeomorphism of order dividing three is the identity. Thus the six components form two three-cycles. Isolated points contribute zero length; the replay did not count all such points. The uploaded verifier was not executed.
